claims.text: Reliance BP Mobility Limited (RBML) operated a country-wide network of 2,221 outlets in Q1 FY2026-27, up from 1,991 in Q1 FY2025-26.
RBML’s Motor Spirit (MS) volumes grew 16.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.
RBML’s High-Speed Diesel (HSD) volumes decreased by 1.9% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.
Jio-bp Pulse crossed a monthly footfall of over 50,000 customers in Q1 FY2026-27, supported by an expanding fast-charging network of 5,820 live charging points.
RBML’s CBG network had 131 operating outlets in Q1 FY2026-27, with CBG volumes up 161% year-on-year and CNG volumes up 13% year-on-year.
Reliance Retail’s B2B business delivered steady growth led by higher ABV (+15% year-on-year) and transactions in Q1 FY2026-27.
Grocery Digital Commerce average daily orders were up 116% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27, with digital channel share contributing 13.4% (+160 bps year-on-year) of Grocery B2C revenue.
JioMart serviced approximately 5,500 pin codes and connected 2,500+ Digital and Fashion & Lifestyle stores to two-hour delivery in Q1 FY2026-27.
The active seller base on JioMart grew 26% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.

Reliance Industries’ Energy business delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY2026-27, attributed to deeply integrated O2C operations and agile response to market changes, despite macro challenges and energy market dislocation.
